summary: 1930s 110-foot Aermotor tower in Lunenburg County, Virginia; privately owned, registered 2017, with its coordinates kept unlisted at the owner's request.

Coordinates are unlisted at owner's request

corrections.why: Wikidata places the tower in Lunenburg County and the FFLA Virginia list uses Lunenburg. The Register and the 2015 chapter report use the spelling Lunenberg.

notes_for_editor: Coordinates: the Register says they are unlisted at the owner's request, yet the record's lat/lon matches the FFLA Virginia list and the Wikidata point. Keep coordinates out of public copy and ask a human to decide whether the record should keep them. No build year is given (only 'the 1930s'), so no built event was added. The 2015 report and the Register spell the county Lunenberg; Wikidata and the FFLA list use Lunenburg (see corrections). One WebSearch found no builder or owner history, so the Aermotor claim rests on the Register alone. The FFLA 'Tower Standing' entry is the only status source; not verified on the ground. Height 33.5 m converts the Register's 110 ft.
